Congressman George Latimer and I conducted an oversight inspection of the Delaney Detention Center. The overwhelming majority of the detainees held there have no criminal history. None.

The Trump administration is squandering $1 billion on a detention facility that should not even exist.

trump-administration.quote:
Having Russell Vought as CFPB Director is like having a pope who doesn’t believe in Catholicism. 

If you don’t believe in consumer protection, why lead the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau?

Russell Vought is wrong.  

187 years before Project 2025, the Supreme Court emphatically rejected Russell Vought’s theory that a president has the constitutional authority to suspend spending laws enacted by Congress.

Russell Vought has repeatedly asserted that Donald Trump has the power to suspend spending laws enacted by Congress.

I asked Mr. Vought whether, under his theory, the President could unilaterally defund the DOD, the Supreme Court, Social Security, and Medicare. 

He refused to answer.

The notion of an authoritarian President accepting a $400 million gift from a foreign monarch would have been utterly horrifying to the founding fathers, who sought to protect the presidency from corrupting foreign influence.

Donald Trump ran for President promising to drain the swamp.  Instead, he became the swamp.  

The acceptance of a $400 million Qatari Air Force One has revealed his presidency for what it is and has always been: a cesspool of corruption.

The greatest scandal is not that Donald Trump is failing to avoid the appearance of corruption. The greatest scandal is that he is not even trying.

His acceptance of a $400 million luxury jet from Qatar—a “palace in the sky”—is the latest chapter in the unfolding story of a corrupt presidency.
